name: Fit CSD
summary: Fit Constrained spherical deconvolution (CSD) model to diffusion data (dipy_fit_csd)
description: Wraps the DIPY 1.1.1 dipy_fit_csd workflow: estimates a single-fibre response function from high-FA voxels in a central ROI, fits constrained spherical deconvolution within the mask, and extracts peaks and spherical-harmonic coefficients (peaks and metrics, --extract_pam_values). Use it to obtain fibre orientations for tractography. Requires a DWI with bvals/bvecs and a brain mask in the same space.

inputs.description: Diffusion-weighted image with its bvals and bvecs.
Brain mask restricting the CSD fit.
inputs.requirements: Must be in the same space as the DWI.

outputs.description: CSD peaks and metrics from dipy_fit_csd: peaks, peak values and indices, SH coefficients, GFA and the PAM5 file.

parameters.description: Threshold used to find b=0 directions
Radius of cubic ROI in voxels (default 10)
FA threshold for calculating the response function (default 0.7)
Spherical harmonics order (default 6) used in the CSA fit.

Spherical harmonics order used for peak_from_model to compress
the ODF to spherical harmonics coefficients (default 8)

citations.text: Garyfallidis E, Brett M, Amirbekian B, et al. Dipy, a library for the analysis of diffusion MRI data. Front Neuroinform 8:8 (2014).
